text:
today

I met a genius on the train

about six years old;

he sat beside me and,

as the train

ran along the coast,

we came to the ocean.

the boy looked at me and said:

"the sea isn't pretty at all."


it was the first time

I realized

that.

translation.title: I Met a Genius
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the child's deflating statement and the speaker's sudden agreement.
